text: Add a command for the read-only host-rules check (crates/athena-core host_rules, added in 837b812), for example athena check --host-rules, which reports for athena/records whether force pushes and deletion are forbidden and for main whether branches must be up to date, and exits non-zero when one is not in force. Acceptance: the command exists and is in --help; a test with fixture replies shows the exit code and text for in-force and not-in-force; it makes only GET requests.
